top_signals.title: S&P 500 Tumbles Most Since April 2025 on AI Fears: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A post-election slide in chipmakers snowballed as investors bailed from technology shares on speculation that congressional Democrats will clamp down on the artificial-intelligence industry.
